purpose: Check intrinsic feasibility under new contract before large-scale solves; no solver execution and no cost labels used
rules: For each customer independently: absolute demand<=Q; direct depot-customer path with closed return unless O within L; service start after travel/wait within customer TW; service+closed return within explicit depot deadline if present. Pure pickup routes permitted; unlimited vehicles.
scope: These sufficient single-customer routes demonstrate input feasibility, not feasibility of any native solver output or complete release.
